tools.description: Search available tools by natural language query. Returns top 5 tools ranked by semantic relevance and health score. Unhealthy or zombie tools are automatically deprioritized.

query.description: Natural language description of what you need

server_filter.description: Optional: limit to specific server name

tools.name: gateway_search_tools

tools.description: Invoke a backend tool by its tool_id. Automatically retries on transient failures and falls back to alternative tools if available.

allow_fallback.description: Reserved for compatible fallback policies; disabled for side-effecting tools

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema

confirmed.description: Must be true before executing write or destructive tools

tools.name: gateway_invoke

tools.description: Return a health summary of all connected MCP servers and their tools. Includes zombie detection and degradation warnings.

time_window_days.description: Time window for statistics in days

tools.name: gateway_health_report

tools.description: Retrieve a privacy-preserving decision trace by trace_id. Traces contain routing and execution metadata, never tool arguments or results.

trace_id.description: trace_id returned by gateway_search_tools or gateway_invoke

tools.name: gateway_get_trace

tools.description: Analyze tool usage patterns and suggest which MCP servers or tools to remove to reduce context bloat. Returns actionable recommendations.

aggressive.description: If true, flag tools unused for 3+ days instead of 7

tools.name: gateway_suggest_cleanup
